name: pulse-fit-14
description: Pulse Fit gym management platform monorepo.

scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run db:migrations:validate && npm run build
scripts.db:migrations:validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='services/api/db/migrations';const f=fs.readdirSync(p).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.sql')).sort();if(!f.length)throw new Error('No SQL migrations found');const v=new Set();for(const n of f){const m=n.match(/^(\d+)_[-a-z0-9_]+\.sql$/);if(!m)throw new Error('Invalid migration name '+n);if(v.has(m[1]))throw new Error('Duplicate migration version '+m[1]);v.add(m[1]);const s=fs.readFileSync(p+'/'+n,'utf8');if(!s.trim())throw new Error('Empty migration '+n);if(!s.includes('schema_migrations'))throw new Error('Migration '+n+' must maintain schema_migrations');}console.log('validated '+f.length+' migrations');"
